about_the_game: The Under the Island (Selections from the Original Game Soundtrack) is Eddie Marianukroh's contribution to the soundtrack for the charming 2D Action RPG Under the Island by Slime King Games. Standing alongside the main composer Miyoko Takaoka and co-composer Robert Kilpatrick, Marianukroh provides six tracks of his own to further accompany the wonderful adventures of Nia on Seashell Island.
